questions: I want to see redwoods. Is it better to go to Humboldt or Henry Cowell?
Mistral-7B:
Both Henry Cowell Redwoods State Park and Humboldt Redwoods State Park offer unique redwood experiences. Henry Cowell Redwoods State Park is located closer to the Bay Area and has a more diverse forest ecosystem, including redwoods, Douglas fir, madrone, oak, and ponderosa pine. It also features a visitor center and nature store, camping, picnicking, and hiking.

Humboldt Redwoods State Park, on the other hand, is known for its impressive old-growth redwoods, some of which are over 300 feet tall. The park is home to the Avenue of the Giants, a scenic drive that offers excellent opportunities to see redwoods by car. Humboldt Redwoods State Park also offers camping, picnicking, hiking, and three scenic drives.

If you're looking for a more diverse forest ecosystem and are closer to the Bay Area, Henry Cowell Redwoods State Park might be the better choice for you. However, if you're looking for the tallest and most impressive old-growth redwoods, Humboldt Redwoods State Park is the place to go.

Sources:
- Henry Cowell Redwoods State Park information from <https://www.parks.ca.gov/?page_id=546>
- Humboldt Redwoods State Park information from <https://www.parks.ca.gov/?page_id=425>
